An unidentified '''safety spokesperson''' worked for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] spaceline<ref name="EE">{{EndorExpress|url=database/safety-spokesperson|text=Database: Safety Spokesperson}}</ref> around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="LC blog">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> She reminded travelers of the regulations when flying Star Tours, in a particular language.<ref name="OST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref> In performing that duty, she was successor of the [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service unit]] nicknamed [[Aly San San/Legends|Aly San San]], who had filled the role<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> for some time, starting around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="ST2 date">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Unidentified Star Tours safety spokesperson|Other]] [[Unidentified Star Tours safety spokespeople (Tokyo)|spokespeople]] also reminded passengers of regulations in other languages than she used.

==Behind the scenes==
Though the [[Unidentified Star Tours safety spokesperson|safety spokesperson]] for the original California and Florida joint [[Lucasfilm]]&ndash;[[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Company]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] was portrayed by [[Stephanie Taylor]], three other actors were featured in the safety videos seen at [[Tokyo Disneyland]] speaking in Japanese. This spokesperson here was featured at [[Disneyland Paris]] speaking in French. Droid Aly San San was later shown using all language variations in the safety video for ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' starting in [[2011]].
